tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List all discoverable apps and their current status.

tools.name: stop_app
tools.description: Stop a running app by id.

tools.name: register_app
tools.description: Register a sibling project directory that has no .hub.json as a startable app (machine-local, written to registrations.json). Rejected if the directory already has a .hub.json. Multi-route apps (a routes array) can't be expressed in this schema — register those by hand-editing registrations.json directly.

tools.name: unregister_app
tools.description: Remove a machine-local registration for a sibling project (from registrations.json). Has no effect on a project with its own .hub.json.
